command: pre-registration: five-model break atlas, fresh familiar-layout states k = 36-55

metrics.mapping: BREAK_ATLAS's registered estimator and labels (pp_atlas.py's stage rule, partners, bootstrap B = 2000 rng seed 0; read through experiments/pp_atlas_fresh_read.py, which runs pp_atlas_models_read.py's read_models unchanged except output dir, state list and familiar-only layout loop), per model (pi05, groot, pi0, xvla, smolvla), familiar layout, on the 20 fresh states k = 36-55 (harness trials 24-43, seed_base 13000000 + 1000 k), 11 tasks (K1, K2, K3, K4, K6, N1-N6). Replication verdicts: F1 REPLICATES iff the cross-chunk break (group 'cross' CI lower bound > 0 and E > .10) holds on at least 3 of the 4 models where it held on the development states (pi0.5, GR00T, pi0, X-VLA). F2 REPLICATES iff the within-chunk GRASP excess (stage GRASP, same bar: CI lower bound > 0 and E > .10) holds on both pi0 and SmolVLA.
metrics.prediction: F1 REPLICATES and F2 REPLICATES; the five familiar-layout verdicts match the development read on at least 4 of 5 models.
metrics.seen: development-state five-model read (results/flawed/pp_atlas_more_read.json); no fresh state rolled before this row
metrics.written_before: any rollout on a fresh state (smoke included) of any model
